title: Case: Carrier confirms a parcel is lost after investigation
context: The carrier has completed its trace and confirmed loss. The recipient has chosen a replacement; the merchant must approve and create it.
initial_request:
I still need the kettle from TG-4970. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

events.body: Final trace record INV-1516: DL-4109 could not be located after the completed depot and route search; carrier status is confirmed lost. This finding does not itself create a merchant replacement order.

I still need the kettle from TG-4970. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Confirmed loss does not mean the desk can approve replacement or claim its delivery.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-025: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
